title: Beethoven's Life In Reverse, From Vienna Back to Bonn #Shorts
description:
Beethoven's life runs backwards, from his death in Vienna in 1827 to his baptism in Bonn in 1770. The five steps pass the symphony of 1824 that he could not hear, the Heiligenstadt letter of 1802, the Vienna of Napoleon and the keyboard lessons his father arranged for a small boy. Dates follow the documented record.

Made with AI assistance.

#Beethoven #Biography #LifeInReverse #Shorts #ClassicalMusic #Composers #Documentary

scenes.narration: A crowd followed his coffin through Vienna in 1827 while bands played and poets spoke at the grave of a composer who had been deaf for two decades.
Step backwards and his ninth symphony fills a hall in 1824 with singers he cannot hear, while hands turn him round to face the applause.
Further back, in 1802, he writes to his brothers that his hearing is failing and decides to keep working anyway, because his music matters more than conversation.
Before that he is a young pianist in Vienna in the 1790s, learning counterpoint for money and playing for courts that paid in compliments and arrears.
At the start there is a boy born in 1770 in a Rhine town to a court singer who drank and set his son at the keyboard for hours a day.
